text: The teardown processes the current thread while hasPendingEvents is true after stopping its fake server. It adds no fixed deadline, later-timer check or result assertion. Accepted code retains the drain while separately changing the preceding server check. Treat this as a local cleanup sequence, not proof of a timeout cure or global event-loop quiescence.
title: The IMAP noselect teardown drains pending thread events after stopping the fake server
